mcqs.question: Under Andhra Pradesh’s BHAVYA initiative, what is the planned scale and investment during 2026–27 to 2031–32?
options: 100 parks with an outlay of ₹33,660 crore
100 parks with an outlay of ₹1,973 crore
33,660 parks with an outlay of ₹100 crore
1973 parks with an outlay of ₹33,660 crore
mcqs.explanation: BHAVYA aims to develop 100 parks during 2026–27 to 2031–32 with an outlay of ₹33,660 crore. The other options interchange or alter the number of parks and the investment amount.

mcqs.question: Who was appointed Executive Chairman of the Andhra Pradesh State Legal Services Authority?
mcqs.explanation: Justice Ravinath Tilhari was appointed Executive Chairman of the Andhra Pradesh State Legal Services Authority. Lisa Gill is the Chief Justice of the Andhra Pradesh High Court, while the Governor makes the appointment on the Chief Justice’s recommendation.
